svg.title: Pairwise merging and listwise SD / LT
svg.desc: One two-way merge baseline with k=2,h=1 compares two run heads and emits the smaller item. SD with k=4,h=2 connects four run-prefix leaves to a common root and ranks the eight selected items. LT with k=8,h=2 ranks four segments along a refresh path, enclosed by a smooth dashed curve. Ellipses below the leaves indicate the remaining items in the sorted runs.

g.text: (b) Sliding Window · fan-in k = 4, head h = 2
(c) Loser Tree · fan-in k = 8, head h = 2
